<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TriggerBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NotificationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CancelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SettlementMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SignUp" name="Customer signs up for subscription">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInfo" name="Enter personal and payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NotificationMerge" name="Subscription ongoing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send update, enhancement or renewal notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CancelSplit" name="Customer cancels?" default="Flow_9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitCancel" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsSplit" name="Refund due under terms?" default="Flow_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SettlementMerge" name="Refund or charge applied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_EnterInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterInfo" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_NotificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_NotificationMerge" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_CancelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="Cancellation requested" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelSplit" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${cancellationRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Subscription continues" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_NotificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancel" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_TermsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${refundDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_SettlementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_SettlementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_SettlementMerge" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
